name: obo
description: OBO (Open Biomedical Ontology) file comparison configuration. Masks arbitrary term IDs and ignores metadata fields that vary by author/time but don't affect semantic content.

_comments.mask_ids: Masks CURIE-format IDs (GO:0000001 → GO:NNNNNNN). Essential for ontologies since new term IDs are arbitrary but semantically equivalent if the content is the same.
ignore_keys: created_by: Author who created the term. Varies by person, not semantic.
creation_date: When term was added. Varies by time, not semantic.
dcterms-date: ISO format date field. Varies by time, not semantic.
dc-contributor: Dublin Core contributor field. Varies by author, not semantic.
custom_normalizers: mask_timestamps: Normalizes date fields like 2024-01-15T10:30:00Z to YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ
mask_version_numbers: Normalizes data-version field changes like 1.2.3 → X.Y.Z
_comments.use_case: Compare human ontology PR with agent-generated PR. Example: 'Add new term for protein binding' - human uses GO:0000001, agent uses GO:0000999. Should be considered identical if all other content matches.
typical_workflow: 1. Human fixes ontology issue, creates PR with new term
2. Agent attempts same fix, generates PR with (possibly different) new term ID
3. metadiff compares diffs using this config
4. Result: similarity=1.0 if semantic content matches (ID differences ignored)
